claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons
claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show 'MANGO' brand plate on a wall-mounted salon bonnet hood dryer, matching the described item.
No photo or document (purchase receipt, usage log) can confirm age or duration of use from images alone.
Photos show cosmetic exterior only; no shot of heating element, motor running, or internal wiring to confirm functional 'perfect' condition.

risks.risk: Heating element or motor may not function correctly
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powered on, hood heating up and blower running with audible airflow
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: Internal wiring or power cord may be damaged or unsafe
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of plug, cord insulation, and any exposed wiring

risks.risk: Voltage/power rating may not match standard Nigerian supply or may be mismatched for salon use
risks.proof: Clear photo of rating plate showing voltage/wattage specs
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown compatibility, worst case requiring converter or rewiring

risks.risk: Wall bracket/mount may not be included in sale (fixed to seller's wall)
risks.proof: Photo confirming bracket is detachable and included, or seller's explicit written confirmation with image of removed unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as dryer only, bracket excluded

risks.risk: Unknown repair or servicing history (could mask prior breakdown)
risks.proof: Any service receipts, screenshots of purchase/repair records
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, treated as higher risk of future failure

risks.risk: Missing accessories or non-functional timer/dial controls
risks.proof: Video showing both dials being turned and timer function activating with indicator light response
risks.if_unproven: priced as basic unit only, no confirmed extra functions

proof_requests: Video of the dryer powered on, hood heating and blower running
Close-up photo of the rating/voltage plate
Close-up of power cord and plug condition
Confirmation and photo showing bracket is included/detachable
Any purchase or repair receipts if available
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Mango wall-mounted salon bonnet dryer, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified functional claims and missing proof of condition, age, and completeness.
